$comment: Feature 021: Maxima Library Lookup Service v2 integration (English). Deep-merged into en.json by i18n/index.ts.

tabs.maximaLibrary: Optional live catalog autocomplete and identity lookup via Maxima Library Lookup Service v2

maximaLibrary.enable: Enable optional live lookup against Maxima Library in the Description view
maximaLibrary.domain: Base HTTPS address of the Maxima Library server (default https://maxima-library.com)
maximaLibrary.token: Personal read-only Lookup Access Token from your Maxima Library user settings
maximaLibrary.revealToken: Show or hide the Access Token
maximaLibrary.tokenLink: Open Maxima Library token settings in your external web browser
maximaLibrary.test: Verify connectivity and token validity before saving

maximaLookup.bannerRetry: Retry the last failed Maxima Library lookup request
maximaLookup.bannerSettings: Open Settings on the Maxima Library integration tab
maximaLookup.bannerDismiss: Dismiss this Maxima Library lookup status notice
maximaLookup.pickItem: Apply this Maxima Library record to the current field
maximaLookup.prevPage: Show the previous page of Maxima Library suggestions
maximaLookup.nextPage: Show the next page of Maxima Library suggestions
maximaLookup.close: Close the Maxima Library suggestion list

settings.enableHint: Disabled by default. When enabled, lookup requests are sent only when you interact with supported fields in the Description view.
settings.tokenPlaceholder: Paste your personal Lookup Access Token
settings.tokenStoredPlaceholder: Saved encrypted token (enter a new token to replace)
settings.tokenHelp: Generate or manage your read-only personal Lookup Access Token on Maxima Library:
settings.statusVerified: Verified: connection and Access Token succeeded.
settings.statusTestRequired: Click "Test integration" and wait for a successful check before Apply or OK can be saved.
settings.statusUnreadable: The saved encrypted Access Token could not be decrypted (for example, missing key file or file corruption). Re-enter your token and click "Test integration".
settings.unavailable: Maxima Library settings are unavailable: the editor core is not connected.

errors.invalidDomain: Enter a valid Maxima Library address (for example https://maxima-library.com).
errors.httpsRequired: Remote Maxima Library domains must use HTTPS.
errors.emptyToken: Enter a Maxima Library Access Token before testing.
errors.tokenUnreadable: The saved encrypted token cannot be read. Paste a token and test again.
errors.unauthorized: Authentication failed: the server did not receive a valid Bearer token.
errors.invalid_token: The Access Token is invalid or has been revoked on Maxima Library.
errors.account_disabled: Your Maxima Library account is disabled for lookup access.
errors.https_required: The Maxima Library server requires an HTTPS connection.
errors.wrong_version: Protocol version mismatch: update the editor to match the server's Lookup Service version.
errors.rate_limited: Too many requests. Wait before trying again.
errors.rate_limited_retry: Too many requests. Wait {{seconds}} s before trying again.
errors.method_not_allowed: The server rejected the lookup HTTP method.
errors.invalid_request: The lookup request was rejected by the server.
errors.server_error: The Maxima Library server returned a temporary error. Try again later.
errors.offline: Could not reach the Maxima Library server. Check your network connection.
errors.timeout: The request to Maxima Library timed out.
errors.tls: TLS certificate verification failed for the configured domain.
errors.http: The server returned an unexpected HTTP response.
errors.format: The configured address did not return a valid Lookup Service v2 response.

lookup.unresolvedTooltip: Multiple Maxima Library records match this exact name; pick one from the list if desired (does not block saving)
lookup.pickOnePrompt: Multiple records share this exact name. Pick one below (optional):

banner.offline: Maxima Library is unreachable. Offline editing and saving continue normally.
banner.invalidToken: Maxima Library Access Token was rejected or revoked. Update it in Settings.
banner.accountDisabled: Maxima Library account is disabled for lookup requests.
banner.rateLimited: Maxima Library rate limit reached. Paused briefly ({{seconds}} s).
banner.wrongVersion: Maxima Library lookup protocol version mismatch. Check for an editor update.
banner.serverError: Maxima Library returned a temporary server error. Offline editing continues normally.
